angle: Unlike formula-first treatments of the same nodes, this video fits a Normal to mouse-weight data by visibly sliding candidate centres and spreads along a likelihood curve until the peak is found.
angle_detail: Watch [03:25] through [04:07] first, because the centre-scanning demo is the whole MLE idea in miniature, then continue to [04:55] for the same scan applied to the spread. Finish with [05:22] to [05:48], which pins down the probability-versus-likelihood wording the course will test. Do not expect a density formula or a real derivation here: the Normal shape is assumed familiar from [01:13] on, and the MSE bridge is never computed, so pair this with a derivation source.
